title: PROFIBUS DP
summary: PROFIBUS DP is a serial fieldbus (RS-485) with a master polling slaves cyclically by address. It remains common in existing plants.

sections.heading: Key ideas
sections.body: Each slave has an address (typically 1..125) and a GSD file describing it. The bus needs termination at both physical ends; baud rate is set on the master.

sections.heading: Typical faults
sections.body: Missing or extra termination, wrong addresses, cable damage and connectors with termination switched on in the middle of a segment.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: PLC Lab does not simulate this protocol. This article is background knowledge; no conformance or interoperability is claimed.
